title: Finite cohomology of derived Hom into a finite module
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], let $K\in D(A)$ in the ordinary module derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], let $u\in\mathbf Z$, and let $N$ be a finitely generated $A$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Assume that each $H^j(K)$ is finitely generated and that $H^j(K)=0$ for every $j>u$, where $H^j$ is standard derived cohomology [def-weil-derived-category-cohomology-functor]. Write $N[0]$ for the complex concentrated in degree zero, and use the derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] on the one-object site with only the identity covering and coefficient ring $A$. Then, for every $t\in\mathbf Z$, the $A$-module $H^t(R\operatorname{Hom}_A(K,N[0]))$ is finitely generated, and it is zero for $t<-u$.

source.place: Tag 0D0C, lemma-coherent-internal-hom, proof: the algebra problem and the two displayed Ext spectral sequences.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-source-hyperext-module-target] to $A,K,N,u$. Its hypotheses require only the commutative ring and the assumed upper cohomological bound on $K$. We obtain the $A$-linear spectral sequence $E_2^{i,j}=\operatorname{Ext}^i_A(H^{-j}(K),N)$ with support $i\geq0$, $j\geq-u$, differential bidegree $(s,1-s)$, and the next-page kernel/image identifications. Its abutment is $T^t=H^t(R\operatorname{Hom}_A(K,N[0]))$, with a finite exhaustive separated filtration whose successive quotients are $E_\infty^{t-j,j}$ for $-u\leq j\leq t$. This is the ordinary module derived Hom stipulated in the item, since the cited statement uses precisely the same one-object identity-covering site.

source.place: Tag 0G20, remark-spectral-sequences-ext-variant, renumbered E2 spectral sequence; second displayed spectral sequence in perfect.tex Tag 0D0C.

proof.text: For every $i\geq0$ and every $j$, apply [lem-sc-ext-noetherian-finite] with source module $M=H^{-j}(K)$ and target $N$. Both are finitely generated by the hypotheses, and $A$ is Noetherian, so $E_2^{i,j}$ is finitely generated. For $i<0$ the page-2 term is zero by step 1, hence is generated by the empty set. Thus every page-2 term is finitely generated, including the zero terms outside the support.

source.place: Tag 08YR, lemma-ext-noetherian, applied in the final sentence of perfect.tex Tag 0D0C.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-noetherian-quadrant-abutment] to this spectral sequence with $a=0$ and $b=-u$. Step 2 verifies its page-2 finiteness assumption; step 1 verifies the support, $A$-linearity, next-page identifications and finite exhaustive separated abutment filtrations. Index the latter by the first coordinate $p=t-j$: the quotients are $E_\infty^{p,t-p}$ for $0\leq p\leq t+u$, extending the filtration constantly by $T^t$ to the left and by zero to the right. Outside this interval both the graded pieces and the corresponding limiting terms vanish by the support. If $t<-u$, the interval is empty and the source-sequence lemma already gives $T^t=0$; the constant zero filtration has all the required graded pieces. The quadrant lemma therefore gives finite generation of every $T^t$ and the bound $T^t=0$ for $t<a+b=-u$, exactly the two conclusions.
